history.titleZh: 苹果研究人员利用“Minions”将闲置Mac变成虚拟GPU云
history.descriptionZh:
苹果研究人员在 arXiv 论文中披露，并在苹果机器学习研究网站分享了其内部运行的一个名为 Minions 的系统。它是一个由闲置 Mac 组成的“虚拟 GPU 云”，专门用于 AI 推理，依赖 Apple Silicon。该系统旨在缓解内部 AI 算力紧张：一些任务曾在公司 GPU 队列中等待 10 多个小时，而 Minions 可把这些停滞任务分发到网络中的 Mac 上，将等待时间压缩到几分钟。用户在公司 Slack 中发出请求即可启动流程，但研究者也注意到一个常见顾虑：团队数据可能运行在本团队之外的设备上。

背景上，AI 相关负载正日益受到算力瓶颈限制。苹果在 7 月最新季度文件中承认，它“依赖足够计算资源”，而生态面临“供应受限、交付周期延长和成本上升”；即使拥有自有数据中心和第三方云，也可能无法“确保足够容量”，这使 Minions 方案更具现实意义。此前，苹果的 Private Cloud Compute——Apple Intelligence 中处理复杂请求的服务器端——已开始在 Google Cloud 的 Nvidia GPU 上运行，该消息在 6 月 WWDC 首次公布。与此同时，本地 AI 需求导致 Mac 需求激增，时任 CEO Tim Cook 4 月称 Mac mini 和 Mac Studio 供应可能需要数月才能追上；7 月财报电话还提到先进节点限制和内存成本上涨。

技术架构上，Minions 由 Minion Server、Minion Executor 和 Minion Watchdog 组成。Minion Server 将提交的任务拆分为子任务，存入 PostgreSQL 数据库。每台参与的 Mac 上运行 Minion Executor，通过 REST API 拉取下一个子任务；系统没有中央调度器，属于“拉取式执行模型”。Mac 从 Amazon S3 读取输入，必要时获取模型，在自己的 GPU 上运行子任务，再把结果返回 S3。它只处理两类工作：使用开源 Hugging Face transformer 模型生成嵌入，以及通过安装在每台 Mac 上的 Ollama 用大语言模型进行文本生成。Minion Watchdog 通过跟踪 Mac 每 5 分钟发送的心跳来捕获失败；当 Mac 睡眠、掉线、关机，或用户为取回机器控制权而停止执行器时，未完成子任务会回到队列。Mac 所有者可决定优先接收哪些任务，例如通过“动态任务绑定”偏好某团队或项目的任务，也可使用默认先进先出策略。论文并未显示模型被拆分到多台 Mac，而是每台 Mac 在自己的工作片段上运行完整模型；这类似 OpenClaw 爱好者在家庭实验室中的做法，也与 SETI@home、Folding@home 等志愿计算模式相似。

在性能与收益方面，论文称除了缩短 GPU 队列，Minions 请求不需要新的 GPU 请求，基础设施成本归零，扩展方式从手动变为有机增长；但这些收益未计入电费和硬件磨损。参与方式非正式，团队成员可发 Slack 消息请求他人临时运行 Minion Executor，并针对特定项目或任务。保密性仍是内部工作的担忧，苹果试图通过团队和组织范围的部署、各自数据库以及独立 Mac 池来缓解。

影响上，Minions 目前只在苹果内部充当溢出 AI 容量。作者表示，未来工作将把 Minions 扩展到分布式模型训练；更广泛地说，如果跨组织甚至全球社区的闲置 Mac 能“安全联邦化”，它们可形成共享 GPU 池。该论文出现在算力日益成为 AI 工作负载瓶颈的时期，对利用闲置设备补充推理容量具有参考意义。

history.title: Nvidia GPU prices spike in Japan; prices up to 41% higher than Amazon US

history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 1 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter A Redditor has shared a photograph of the prices of Nvidia RTX 50-series GPUs in Japan, and it doesn’t bode well for gamers. According to u/Chaise91’s post on the r/pcmasterrace subreddit, retail prices for some of the best gaming GPUs are somewhere between 5.66% and 41.1% higher compared to Amazon U.S. listings.The memory chip shortage and massive demand for AI compute have been affecting the supply of gaming GPUs, with reports suggesting Nvidia is planning to halt RTX 5090 production in favor of AI data center and professional GPUs. Because of this, the supply of high-end GPUs has vanished online, with third-party sellers now demanding almost $10,000 if you want to buy one. The image shared on the social media platform does not show the RTX 5090, so we fear that retailers in the market no longer have the high-end graphics card in stock, leading to supply pressure on the lower-tier cards. We built a table comparing the prices from the Japanese retailer to listings we found on Amazon based on the current exchange rate of JPY 153.38 for every USD 1, and the hikes vary between 12.71% on average for the RTX 5080 to a jaw-dropping 41.10% for the RTX 5060 Ti 8GB. Note that these are pre-tax prices, though, so your mileage may vary depending on which state you live in. history.titleZh: 英伟达GPU价格在日本飙升，比美国亚马逊高出至多41%
history.descriptionZh:
近日，Reddit用户u/Chaise91在r/pcmasterrace分享日本市场Nvidia RTX 50系列显卡零售价照片，显示日本部分RTX 50显卡比美国亚马逊标价高5.66%至41.1%。Tom's Hardware按1美元兑153.38日元汇率对比后发现，RTX 5080日本平均价约330,514日元（2,154.87美元），比美国税前均价1,911.87美元高12.71%；RTX 5070 Ti平均高20.51%；RTX 5070平均高19.69%；RTX 5060 Ti 16GB平均高25.19%；RTX 5060 Ti 8GB平均高41.10%。计入美国8.5%销售税后，价差缩小至3.88%至30.04%。个别型号在日本反而更便宜，如MSI RTX 5080 Gaming Trio OC税前低7.22%、税后低14.49%，MSI RTX 5070 Ti Gaming Trio OC税后低6.94%，MSI RTX 5080 Ventus 3X OC税后基本持平。但主流型号涨幅仍然明显。

背景是内存芯片短缺和AI计算需求激增。报道称Nvidia计划停止RTX 5090生产，将产能转向AI数据中心和专业GPU，导致高端游戏GPU在线供应几乎消失，第三方卖家要价接近10,000美元。日本价格照片未出现RTX 5090，可能意味着当地零售商已无货，供应压力正传导至RTX 5080及以下产品。技术层面，RTX 50系列基于Blackwell架构并使用GDDR7显存，但当前核心矛盾并非架构创新，而是供应链资源分配：AI GPU与游戏GPU共享先进制程、先进封装和GDDR7/HBM显存产能，而AI训练和推理对数据中心GPU的需求优先，挤压了消费级显卡供给。此前日本已因补货延迟，对16GB VRAM及以上GPU实行配给，并限制SSD、HDD和RAM购买。

日本市场通常比美国贵，尤其GPU，但此次RTX 5070 Ti及以下主流型号的涨幅仍可能预示美国市场走势，因为价格趋势往往西传。类似涨价已在美国、韩国和中国出现：美国RTX 50系列涨至多39%，韩国涨至多30%，中国MSI和七彩虹全系涨至多59%。对游戏玩家而言，这意味着装机成本上升；对AI和数据中心用户，Nvidia优先供应专业GPU则保障了大模型训练、推理、科学计算和专业渲染等场景。原作者认为，若涨价只是日本局部现象最好，但玩家若有购卡计划不宜再拖延，因为涨价可能蔓延至美国。此次报道未提供帧率、功耗等性能参数，核心对比数据是价格与供应状况。

history.content: Across industries, the U.K. is putting the full stack to work — and the scale of deployment is growing fast, from enterprises transforming their businesses to startups solving some of the planet’s hardest problems. NVIDIA is putting that principle into practice, including through a five-year, $250 million compute commitment to strengthen the U.K.’s agentic safety and security research. NVIDIA’s Investments in the UK NVIDIA has been investing in the U.K. startup ecosystem, supporting companies including Basecamp Research, Ineffable Intelligence, Synthesia, Wayve and many more. Today, NVIDIA announced new planned investments in Boltz, Foresight, Hiverge, Prima Mente and Riverlane. Boltz, a London-based AI startup founded by MIT researchers, builds biomolecular models and AI agents that help scientists predict molecular structures and interactions, and design potential new medicines. Foresight, a London-based startup, helps owners of major infrastructure projects, including hyperscale data centers, predict completion dates, mitigate risks and accelerate time to revenue. Hiverge, a Cambridge-based AI startup founded by researchers from Google DeepMind and the University of Cambridge, builds an AI discovery engine that automatically writes and optimizes algorithms for tasks such as faster AI training and complex logistics planning. Prima Mente, a London-based AI biology startup, focuses on building biological foundation models to decode complex diseases and identify novel therapeutic targets, starting with Alzheimer’s, Parkinson’s and ALS. Riverlane, a Cambridge-based quantum computing startup, builds real-time error correction hardware and software that work across all major qubit types, helping quantum computers become reliable enough for practical use. In addition, NVIDIA is partnering with the Earthshot Prize, joining as a Global Alliance Founding Partner to bring compute and technical expertise to innovators working on solutions for the world’s greatest climate and sustainability challenges. Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements Technology Leaders Pioneer Intelligent Solutions Across the UK In energy, Fuse Energy is moving its customer AI onto its own in-house infrastructure, built on NVIDIA B300 Blackwell Ultra, delivering faster, more responsive support to over 450,000 U.K. households. Meanwhile, sovereign AI company Locai Labs released Nemotron-Personas-UK — an open source dataset of one million synthetic personas representing the UK’s demographic, regional and cultural diversity — helping developers build fairer, more representative AI systems. Healthcare In healthcare, OneAdvanced is deploying what it calls the U.K.’s first and most advanced fine-tuned LLM for Primary Care AI-triage — built with NVIDIA Agent Toolkit software and open models — supporting millions of National Health Service patients. Heidi has now integrated NVIDIA Nemotron open models to give clinicians faster access to trusted medical evidence. Speechmatics is deploying Oak, a multilingual medical speech recognition model, using NVIDIA Triton Inference — giving healthcare organizations control over where sensitive patient audio is processed. Apian, Synnovis and NVIDIA are teaming up to use advanced computing and digital simulations using NVIDIA Cosmos to help hospital robots handle the heavy lifting of moving lab samples, freeing up medical staff to focus on patient care. Danaher and NVIDIA are collaborating to advance autonomous science and help accelerate the pace of discovery by bringing accelerated computing, scientific and physical AI into laboratory workflows and instruments. Danaher’s recently announced AI-powered autonomous lab — designed to deliver up to 8x faster discovery of affinity reagents — is using NVIDIA BioNeMo open models within its AI-driven protein design workflows, data and automation technologies that connect design with experimental feedback. Smart Cities On the civic side, Liverpool City Region is building an NVIDIA-powered “City Brain” — a sovereign AI strategy designed as a blueprint for dozens of Unitary Authorities across the U.K. Digital Jersey, Innovation City Belfast and Tees Valley Combined Authority are each exploring how trusted AI compute can serve communities and public services. Financial Services In financial services, LSEG and NVIDIA are bringing GPU-accelerated market analytics to global institutions. Revolut introduced PRAGMA earlier in the year — a foundation model for banking event sequences, pre-trained on 26 million anonymised user histories. PRAGMA has moved from research to real-time scaling. Lloyds Banking Group built ATUM, a transaction foundation model that converts billions of banking transactions into reusable AI. And Starling is developing a banking foundation model trained on Civo’s U.K. sovereign cloud infrastructure. NatWest is collaborating with NVIDIA on Nemotron Voice to better understand how banking customers across the U.K. speak, while Modulr is deploying a network of agents using Nemotron for distinct parts of payment operations. Quantum Quantum is moving from research to systems deployable alongside classical AI, and the U.K. is at the heart of this shift. Riverlane has shown how GPUs can accelerate decoder recalibration workflows used in quantum error correction, helping decoder performance keep pace with real-time changes in quantum hardware behaviour. The work forms part of a broader collaboration exploring how AI, accelerated computing and quantum error-correction technologies can work together to support future quantum systems. Together, these announcements showcase how enterprises, organizations and startups in the U.K. are fostering innovation across the nation. This includes more than 3,100 U.K. companies that are a part of the NVIDIA Inception program for cutting-edge startups. history.titleZh: NVIDIA宣布对英国初创企业生态系统进行新投资
history.descriptionZh:
NVIDIA 正在英国推动从算力基础设施到行业应用的全栈落地。其背景是，英国各行业的 AI 部署规模正快速扩大：企业用 AI 改造业务，初创公司则用 AI 解决全球最棘手的问题。NVIDIA 将这一原则付诸实践，包括一项为期五年、总额 2.5 亿美元的算力承诺，用于强化英国在智能体安全与安保领域的研究。

这些项目的共同技术底座，是 NVIDIA 全栈加速计算：以 GPU 和 AI 工厂提供算力；以 B300 Blackwell Ultra 等平台承载企业自有 AI；以 Nemotron 开放模型与数据集、Agent Toolkit 降低行业模型开发门槛；以 Triton 推理优化部署；以 Cosmos 进行物理世界数字仿真；以 BioNeMo 加速生命科学模型；并以主权云和量子纠错软硬件保障数据控制、合规与可靠性。其创新点在于，把基础模型、AI 智能体、数字孪生和量子纠错从研究推向可部署系统。

在投资布局上，NVIDIA 长期支持英国初创生态，已投资或支持 Basecamp Research、Ineffable Intelligence、Synthesia、Wayve 等公司。此次又宣布计划投资 Boltz、Foresight、Hiverge、Prima Mente 和 Riverlane。Boltz 是伦敦 AI 初创公司，由 MIT 研究人员创立，构建生物分子模型和 AI 智能体，帮助科学家预测分子结构与相互作用，并设计潜在新药。Foresight 帮助大型基础设施项目业主，包括超大规模数据中心，预测完工日期、降低风险并加快收入实现。Hiverge 由 Google DeepMind 和剑桥大学研究人员创立，构建 AI 发现引擎，可自动编写和优化算法，用于加速 AI 训练、复杂物流规划等任务。Prima Mente 是伦敦 AI 生物初创公司，专注构建生物基础模型，解码复杂疾病并识别新治疗靶点，初期聚焦阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病和 ALS。Riverlane 是剑桥量子计算初创公司，构建可跨主要量子比特类型的实时纠错软硬件，帮助量子计算机达到实用可靠性。此外，NVIDIA 还与 Earthshot Prize 合作，成为全球联盟创始合作伙伴，为应对全球气候与可持续挑战的创新者提供算力和技术专长。

能源与主权 AI 方面，Fuse Energy 正将客户 AI 迁移到基于 NVIDIA B300 Blackwell Ultra 的自有基础设施上，为超过 45 万英国家庭提供更快、更灵敏的支持。主权 AI 公司 Locai Labs 发布了 Nemotron-Personas-UK，这是一个包含 100 万个合成人物画像的开源数据集，体现英国人口、区域和文化多样性，帮助开发者构建更公平、更具代表性的 AI 系统。

医疗健康领域，OneAdvanced 正在部署其称为英国首个且最先进的初级护理 AI 分诊微调大模型，基于 NVIDIA Agent Toolkit 软件和开放模型构建，支持数百万英国国家医疗服务体系患者。Heidi 已集成 NVIDIA Nemotron 开放模型，让临床医生更快获取可信医学证据。Speechmatics 正在部署多语言医疗语音识别模型 Oak，使用 NVIDIA Triton 推理，使医疗机构能够控制敏感患者音频的处理位置。Apian、Synnovis 与 NVIDIA 合作，利用先进计算和基于 NVIDIA Cosmos 的数字仿真，帮助医院机器人承担搬运实验室样本等重体力任务，让医务人员专注于患者护理。Danaher 与 NVIDIA 合作推进自主科学，将加速计算、科学 AI 和物理 AI 引入实验室工作流与仪器。Danaher 最近发布的 AI 驱动自主实验室，设计目标是将亲和试剂发现速度提升最高 8 倍，其 AI 驱动蛋白质设计工作流、数据与自动化技术采用 NVIDIA BioNeMo 开放模型，将设计与实验反馈连接起来。

智慧城市方面，利物浦城市区域正在建设 NVIDIA 驱动的“城市大脑”，这是一项主权 AI 战略，旨在为英国数十个单一制地方当局提供蓝图。Digital Jersey、贝尔法斯特创新城和蒂斯谷联合管理局也在分别探索可信 AI 算力如何服务社区和公共服务。

金融服务方面，LSEG 与 NVIDIA 正在为全球机构带来 GPU 加速的市场分析。Revolut 今年早些时候推出 PRAGMA，这是一个面向银行事件序列的基础模型，基于 2600 万条匿名用户历史预训练，已从研究阶段进入实时扩展。Lloyds Banking Group 构建了 ATUM，这是一个交易基础模型，可将数十亿银行交易转化为可复用 AI。Starling 正在基于 Civo 的英国主权云基础设施开发银行基础模型。NatWest 与 NVIDIA 合作开发 Nemotron Voice，以更好理解英国各地银行客户的说话方式；Modulr 则使用 Nemotron 部署智能体网络，用于支付运营的不同环节。

量子计算方面，量子技术正从研究走向可与经典 AI 并部署的系统，英国处于这一转变的核心。Riverlane 展示了 GPU 如何加速量子纠错中的解码器重校准工作流，帮助解码器性能跟上量子硬件行为的实时变化。这项工作属于更广泛合作的一部分，探索 AI、加速计算和量子纠错技术如何协同支持未来量子系统。

总体来看，这些公告展示了英国企业、机构和初创公司如何在全国推动创新。目前已有超过 3100 家英国公司加入 NVIDIA Inception 前沿初创企业计划。NVIDIA 创始人兼 CEO 黄仁勋将于 10 月 21 日星期三中欧夏令时上午 11 点在 GTC 柏林发表主题演讲，更多 NVIDIA 在欧洲的公告也可查阅。

history.title: European Cities Deploy NVIDIA-Powered AI Agents to Run Smarter Urban Operations
history.description: Keeping a city running means making decisions that affect residents every day — from when to repair a road to how to use energy more efficiently. history.content: Keeping a city running means making decisions that affect residents every day — from when to repair a road to how to use energy more efficiently. Across the EMEA region, cities and local software, infrastructure and integration partners are using NVIDIA accelerated computing to build physical AI agents and digital twins that help teams make those decisions. These applications can anticipate maintenance needs, guide urban planning and make public services more responsive. Software partners including ABA Technology, Akila, Galene AI, Honeywell Technologies, K2K, Linker Vision, Milestone, Onetera, ThinkDeep and Younite AI are using NVIDIA physical and agentic AI to develop solutions for city operations and public services. https://blogs.nvidia.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/linker-vision.mp4 Video courtesy of Linker Vision. NVIDIA Cosmos open models and the NVIDIA Metropolis Blueprint for video search and summarization (VSS) help agents interpret video and identify conditions, such as traffic congestion, equipment condition, underused spaces and safety hazards, that need attention. NVIDIA Nemotron open models enable developers to build agents that reason over information, respond in natural language and deploy digital twins with NVIDIA Omniverse libraries. Projects span Belgium, Finland, France, Italy, the Netherlands, Poland, Sweden, the U.K. and elsewhere. Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements In the U.K., the Liverpool City Region, K2K is exploring how to build AI factories using NVIDIA accelerated computing, Cosmos and the VSS blueprint that can support urban planning and public services — testing applications for mobility and safety. The Island of Jersey is working with K2K to strengthen decision-making, mobility and urban planning while advancing clean energy and public services. Innovation City Belfast is exploring a pilot with K2K focused on smart mobility, transport systems, citizen safety and event and response management. https://blogs.nvidia.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/IKM®-�-Video-GTC-V.10.10.2-compressed.mp4 Video courtesy of K2K. In France, the Department of Côte-d’Or, Akila and ThinkDeep built operations agents that combine sensor, infrastructure and historical data in a sovereign digital twin using NVIDIA Nemotron, Omniverse and accelerated computing, with Cosmos adoption planned for video data. Across more than 500 public buildings, the agents support energy, compliance, safety and climate resilience, and cut document search time from weeks to minutes and reduce total operating costs by 10%, targeting 30% at scale. https://blogs.nvidia.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Akila-CGCO-compressed.mp4 Video courtesy of Akila. In addition, Port Sud de France in Sète is working with ThinkDeep’s agentic platform that uses Cosmos and Nemotron to analyze cargo and safety data, coordinate operations and guide secure handling of hazardous materials. In Italy’s Milan region, Galene.AI, Dell Technologies and TD Synnex are deploying an NVIDIA-powered, locally operated AI factory, starting with Cinisello Balsamo and planning expansion to four additional municipalities. Services include real-time translation, citizen chatbots and assistance with procurement and funding. These applications aim to simplify administrative work and help people get access to municipal data in seconds versus hours, while keeping local governance of data. At Belgium’s Port of Antwerp-Bruges, Milestone and Dell Technologies are testing how agentic vision AI technologies, using NVIDIA Cosmos and the VSS blueprint, could support complex use cases such as oil-spill warnings by training models with synthetic data to prepare for incidents where real-world data is scarce. In the Nordics, Younite AI is developing a digital twin experience with NVIDIA Omniverse libraries for Gothenburg in Sweden as a part of the EU’s Citiverse initiative, focused on helping cities simulate changes and improve accessibility by providing event entrance previews, seating and crowd conditions before arrival. These cities point toward a broader ambition: adapting agentic applications to local needs and extending them across departments and neighboring municipalities and countries such as Poland’s city of Wroclaw. Elsewhere in the region, Honeywell Technologies is deploying Forge Cognition, powered by NVIDIA Nemotron, Cosmos, Omniverse and the VSS blueprint, at the Dubai Fairmont Hotel to connect AI agents with building systems and improve reliability, energy efficiency and operations. https://blogs.nvidia.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/honeywell.mp4 Video courtesy of Honeywell Technologies. Building the AI Infrastructure for European Cities For European cities, scaling from pilots to everyday operations requires infrastructure that can process local data, customize models and run AI agents. System builders and infrastructure partners including Cisco, Dell Technologies, HPE, Lenovo and Supermicro are packaging NVIDIA accelerated computing, networking and storage into locally operated AI factories. These systems let cities customize and run intelligent applications locally while retaining control of their data, models and operations. Nebius and Net Zero Compute are part of the broader ecosystem building AI factories designed to accelerate deployment and reduce costs for agentic services. EY and Accenture provide the integration and operational expertise to connect applications with city systems. Their work helps cities build repeatable deployment blueprints that they can adapt across departments and expand as local needs grow. Learn how NVIDIA and its ecosystem are bringing physical AI, agentic AI and local AI factories to cities worldwide at Smart City Expo World Congress, running Nov. 3-5 in Barcelona. history.titleZh: 欧洲城市部署NVIDIA驱动的AI代理，以实现更智能的城市运营
history.descriptionZh:
在EMEA地区，城市管理者每天都要做出影响居民生活的决策，从何时维修道路到如何更高效地使用能源。如今，当地城市正与软件、基础设施和系统集成伙伴合作，利用NVIDIA加速计算构建物理AI智能体和数字孪生，帮助团队预测维护需求、指导城市规划，并让公共服务响应更快。参与其中的软件伙伴包括ABA Technology、Akila、Galene AI、Honeywell Technologies、K2K、Linker Vision、Milestone、Onetera、ThinkDeep和Younite AI等，它们基于NVIDIA的物理AI与智能体AI开发面向城市运营和公共服务的解决方案。

从技术底座看，这一体系主要由三部分构成：NVIDIA Cosmos开放模型和NVIDIA Metropolis视频搜索与摘要（VSS）蓝图负责让智能体理解视频内容，识别交通拥堵、设备状态、低利用率空间和安全隐患等需要关注的情况；NVIDIA Nemotron开放模型用于构建能够推理信息、以自然语言回应并执行任务的智能体；NVIDIA Omniverse库则支持部署数字孪生，使城市能够在虚拟环境中模拟和优化现实系统。相关项目已覆盖比利时、芬兰、法国、意大利、荷兰、波兰、瑞典、英国等国家和地区。

在英国，利物浦城市区域正与K2K探索如何利用NVIDIA加速计算、Cosmos和VSS蓝图构建AI工厂，以支持城市规划和公共服务，并测试出行与安全应用。泽西岛与K2K合作，希望加强决策、出行和城市规划能力，同时推进清洁能源和公共服务。贝尔法斯特创新城也在与K2K开展试点，重点覆盖智能出行、交通系统、市民安全以及事件与响应管理。

在法国，科多尔省、Akila和ThinkDeep利用Nemotron、Omniverse和加速计算，将传感器、基础设施和历史数据整合进一个主权数字孪生，构建运营智能体，并计划采用Cosmos处理视频数据。该系统覆盖500多栋公共建筑，支持能源、合规、安全和气候韧性管理。效果上，文档检索时间从数周缩短到数分钟，总运营成本降低10%，规模化目标为降低30%。此外，位于塞特的法国南港正与ThinkDeep的智能体平台合作，利用Cosmos和Nemotron分析货物与安全数据、协调运营，并指导危险材料的安全处理。

在意大利米兰地区，Galene.AI、戴尔科技和TD Synnex正在部署由NVIDIA驱动、本地运营的AI工厂，首先落地奇尼塞洛巴尔萨莫，并计划扩展到另外四个市镇。服务包括实时翻译、市民聊天机器人以及采购和资金申请辅助，目标是简化行政工作，让市民在数秒而非数小时内获取市政数据，同时保持数据由本地治理。

在比利时，安特卫普-布鲁日港与Milestone和戴尔科技合作，测试基于Cosmos和VSS蓝图的智能体视觉AI技术，用于支持溢油预警等复杂场景。由于真实世界数据稀缺，他们利用合成数据训练模型，为事故应对做准备。在北欧，Younite AI正在为瑞典哥德堡开发基于Omniverse库的数字孪生体验，作为欧盟Citiverse计划的一部分，帮助城市模拟变化并改善无障碍体验，例如在活动开始前预览入口、座位和人群状况。这些城市案例也指向更广泛的目标：让智能体应用适应本地需求，并跨部门、跨邻近市镇乃至跨国扩展，例如波兰弗罗茨瓦夫。

在中东，Honeywell Technologies正在迪拜费尔蒙酒店部署由Nemotron、Cosmos、Omniverse和VSS蓝图驱动的Forge Cognition，将AI智能体与楼宇系统连接，以提高可靠性、能效和运营水平。

为了从试点走向日常运营，欧洲城市需要能够处理本地数据、定制模型并运行AI智能体的基础设施。思科、戴尔科技、HPE、联想和Supermicro等系统构建商和基础设施伙伴，正在将NVIDIA加速计算、网络和存储打包成本地运营的AI工厂。这类系统让城市在本地定制和运行智能应用，同时保留对数据、模型和运营的控制权。Nebius和Net Zero Compute也是更广泛生态的一部分，致力于建设AI工厂，加速智能体服务部署并降低成本。EY和埃森哲则提供集成与运营专长，将应用与城市系统连接起来，帮助城市建立可重复的部署蓝图，以便跨部门适配并随本地需求扩展。NVIDIA及其生态将在11月3日至5日于巴塞罗那举行的Smart City Expo World Congress上展示这些面向全球城市的物理AI、智能体AI和本地AI工厂方案。
